risks.risk: Export concentration — 61.84% of turnover from exports, single business segment

risks.note: The CFO names foreign exchange movements as one of the exposures requiring 'continuous monitoring and timely action', and cites currency fluctuations among the conditions that created a challenging operating environment. With the majority of revenue earned in foreign currency, translation and transaction risk is structural; the mitigation stated is strengthened treasury management and financial controls.

The MD&A further notes that higher petroleum crude prices from the ongoing US-Iran war have pushed polyester yarn prices up. As a spinner/weaver of premium cotton, input price swings compress margins before they can be passed to customers.
risks.risk: Raw material price volatility — cotton and yarn

risks.note: The Directors' Report states that 'uncertainties caused by ongoing war situations resulted in higher logistics cost, shipping disruptions, extended transit periods, volatility in price and currency led to margin pressures'. currentContext.expansion: VTM's FY26 expansion was a modernisation-and-upgrade cycle at its integrated textile facility at Sulakarai, Virudhunagar, Tamil Nadu, rather than a new greenfield plant. The Company states it invested over Rs.25 crore towards modernization, plant upgrades and capacity building during FY26. Additions include new Rapier looms imported from Italy with Leno attachment capability for manufacturing high-value niche fabrics, PICANOL ULTIMAX Rapier looms with FANCY BEAM attachment imported from Belgium at a cost of Rs.2.13 Cr, one Sectional Warping machine from RABATEX at Rs.1.08 Cr purchased specifically to support Linen fabric production for the Home Textiles business, one Yarn Conditioning Unit from SIEGER at Rs.0.30 Cr to improve quality and loom efficiency, one automatic fabric folding/packing machine at Rs.0.20 Cr, and advanced fabric inspection and packing machines to improve quality assurance. Safety infrastructure was added in the form of a fire hydrant system at Rs.0.92 Cr connecting all departments and raw-material/finished-goods warehouses. On the energy side, VTM significantly expanded renewable capacity by commissioning additional rooftop solar power plants (total captive windmill plus solar capacity of 6.31 MW, which includes a previously commissioned 1.35 MW solar plant), and installed two energy-efficient compressors of 755 CFM each at a total cost of Rs 72.0 lakhs plus energy-efficient supply air fans in the Sulzer department humidification plant. The Board withheld the FY26 dividend explicitly citing 'ongoing and proposed expansion initiatives' and long-term growth requirements, indicating further reinvestment intent, though no named future project, quantum or commissioning timeline is disclosed. The reported capex is directed at manufacturing flexibility, quality consistency and a shift toward higher value-added fabrics and made-ups.
